dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: In a good mood, I see?

dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: Haha, is it that obvious? Well, that's being a parent for you. Nothing makes me happier than seeing my little rascal full of life!

dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: Whenever I feel worn out at work, I stop and take a look toward where my family lives. I just think of the little guy's face, and suddenly I've got my strength back.

dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: You know, ever since I told my Klimochka, "Daddy can see you from down here."

dialogues.speaker: Vvedensky
dialogues.text: You wouldn't believe how excited he's been! His mother says he tries all sorts of ways to show off every day. He's just too cute, hehe.
